items.information:
Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have received the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 100 SEK. For more information about this competition, see the tabs.

Detta är 2019 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Senaste gången var 2015, och detta är den fjärde gången en tävling har arrangerats i denna kommun någonsin.

items.information:
[DE]
Die Swiss Science Open 2019 im Technorama werden nicht nur für Teilnehmer sondern auch für alle registrierten Gäste ein Erlebnis werden. The Swiss Science Open 2019 in the Technorama will be an experience not only for participants but also for all registered guests. All participants and registered guests receive for 15CHF for Sa + Sun free admission to the Technorama. In addition to the Speedcubing Competition in the foyer, you can expect many experiments from the world of physics, which you can try out.
Register yourself and all your escorts (guests) to get free admission to the Technorama for 2 days.

items.name: Kansai Summer 2019
items.information:
関西定例大会夏2019内の3×3×3第一ラウンドで、年齢別「こども大会」（小学生以下）および「マスターズ大会」（35歳以上）を併催します。
対象年齢内での順位を決め、第一ラウンド終了後に表彰を行います(WCA上の入賞とは異なります)。
第一ラウンドで「こども大会」「マスターズ大会」に参加していても、全年齢含めての順位が上位であればそのまま第二ラウンドに進むことができます。

During the first round of 3x3x3 at the Kansai Summer 2019, we will also hold an age-specific “Juniors Competition” (competitors less than primary school children) and "Masters Competition" (competitors of 35 years of age or older).
At the end of this first round, the rankings for each age category will be determined, and awards will be given. These awards are separated from the actual WCA competition.
Even if you join the “Juniors Competition” or the “Masters Competiton” in the first round, you can continue to the second round if your ranking within all participants allows it.
